On Etsy, an "Ultimate Excel Template Bundle: 12,500+ Excel Templates" by ZeeDigitalNest has a confirmed Etsy Bestseller badge ("This item has had a high sales volume over the past 6 months").
The Etsy Bestseller badge indicates "high sales volume within the last 6 months." Etsy does not reveal the specific threshold for earning the badge. The badge is category-dependent.
An Etsy listing (1784469516) titled "All-in-One Digital Planner 2025, 2026, 2027" carries Etsy's official indicator: "This item has had a high sales volume over the past 6 months."
A second Quora user reports 42 products sold in 6 months, placing them in the "top 32% of Etsy sellers."
An aggregation from Reddit r/EtsySellers states new printable shops average $100-300 after 50 listings in the first 0-6 months.
Dina Lu claims $3,000+ in first 6 months on Etsy selling Canva templates; had 35K YouTube subscribers and 5.8K Instagram followers at the time.
India Lindsey priced subsequent ebooks at $29.99–$39.99 on Gumroad, described as a "significant leap" from her $4.99 Amazon price.
India Lindsey's "10K in 30 Days" sold at $29.99, later raised to $39.99 on Gumroad.
On Gumroad, AllThingsTemplate sells an "Ultimate 10-in-One Productivity Bundle (Google Sheets)" for $29.99 (claimed 50% off from >$60).
Cody Berman's friend Julie "spent about 60 hours creating a bunch of digital products and had made over $5,000 so far" as the initial time investment.
A beginner Etsy seller on Reddit estimates approximately 2,500 sales/month needed to reach $5,000 monthly profit at prevailing digital product prices.
X user @ama_a93 stated Etsy reported $5,000 in income to the IRS that the seller never received.

Rhonda reports she switched from Gumroad to Payhip after comparing: Payhip has 5% fee with instant payouts; Gumroad has 10% + $0.30 per sale with 7-day payout processing.
Gumroad charges a flat 10% take rate per sale, plus payment processing (2.9% + $0.30 for Stripe).
Gumroad eliminated tiered pricing in January 2023; previously, high-volume sellers paid as low as 3.5% + $0.30.
An Etsy seller quoted in the same aggregation states: "First time in 3 years without a sale in over a month. It's getting hyper competitive in this sea of over 1M shops."

Etsy shut down their largest download shop, which had 300K+ sales in under 3 years, for selling scraped vintage art as downloads.

Notion Marketplace charges 10% fee + $0.40 per transaction.
A seller reported selling a $5 Notion template and receiving approximately $3.10 after fees, while official math ($5 minus 10% minus $0.40) yields $4.10 -- a $1.00 discrepancy.
A third-party source reports Gumroad charges 10% + $0.50 per transaction for direct sales.
The third-party fee structure differs from Gumroad's own pricing page, which states flat 10% without the $0.50 per-transaction add-on.
Gumroad charges a flat 10% + $0.50 per direct transaction.

Gumroad keeps the full 10% platform fee and the $0.50 transaction fee on all refunds, with no product delivered.
